newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bowne sets up European Test Centre in Dublin.
newsitem.headline: Bowne sets up European Test Centre in Dublin.

text.p: Software localisation group Bowne Global Solutions, a unit of Bowne & Co Inc, on Monday named Wendy Hamilton as vice-president for strategic development and Northern European operations, based in Dublin.
Her responsibilities will include directing a new European Test Centre that provides quality assurance testing for technology products in up to 30 languages, Bowne said in a statement.
Bowne Global Solutions provides software localisation services to many of the world's leading computer software and hardware manufacturers.
